examples.text: We downplay the damage we cause and ignore the people in need outside our tribes.
examples.explanation: 这里的 downplay 表示“淡化、轻描淡写地弱化严重性”，即不充分承认自己造成的伤害。

reviewSessions.example_text: imagined and real ones. We are still brutal to each other and the animals we hold power over. We are still territorial and possessive, we fear losing what we have, and we fear change. We downplay the damage we cause and ignore the people in need outside our tribes. Humans are not nice and if we look at our history, how could we expect ourselves to be? In nature we see great beauty but also endless violence and struggle,
reviewSessions.feedback: 这次没填对，正确答案是 downplay。
missing_points: 需要回忆出目标词 downplay

relations.reason: amplify 表示把影响、问题、声音等“放大、增强、加剧”，而 downplay 表示“淡化、轻描淡写、弱化严重性”，在表达对问题或影响的处理方式时语义相反。
boast 表示夸耀、强调自己的优点或成就；downplay 表示淡化、轻描淡写某事，尤其在谈到成就、能力或问题严重性时，二者构成有学习价值的语义对比。
